attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless podman container (nginx:alpine) on node1 running under the unprivileged appsvc account, published on port 8080, managed by a systemd user Quadlet unit (webapp.container) with linger enabled so it starts at boot without any active login session. Verified via a full node reboot that the boot identity changed and the service/container auto-recovered and served HTTP 200 with the process owned by appsvc.
